name: api-client
title: API client
description: Envelope-aware axios instance with bearer-token auth in memory (no localStorage), httpOnly refresh-cookie rotation, cold-start session bootstrap that tells a signed-out user, a blocked account and an unreachable backend apart, cross-tab Web Lock single-flight 401 retry, proactive token refresh, ADR-048 coded auth-failure classification (SessionFailureKind / CODE_TO_KIND), and UI-agnostic onError/onSessionExpired hooks.
postInstall: Call bootstrapSession() from your entry route and branch on its status: authenticated -> render the app, anonymous -> send to login, unavailable -> stay on the page with a retry (an unreachable backend is not a logout; fewbie ADR-001 / devbie ADR-040). Adjust BASE_URL / legacy storage keys / REFRESH_PATH / REFRESH_LOCK_NAME in src/lib/api-client.ts to match your backend contract.
